## https://monona-sports.com/

# Hoop Mo

Hoop Mo is an AI basketball shooting coach with Live Shoot realtime feedback, Mo chat that knows every shot, and progress tracking that stays with you.

**Live Shoot** (homepage hero): Realtime feedback the moment you release. Talk to Mo, review every phase, and fix form in the gym.

**Stats:** 2000+ shots tracked | 600+ players and coaches | Always with you

## Live Shoot details

Everything you get in a live session: realtime cues, Mo, and a full post-set review.

- **Realtime release feedback:** Get coaching cues as soon as the ball leaves your hand.
- **Talk to Mo:** Say "Hey Mo" or "Hey Monona", ask a question, and get an answer in realtime.
- **Phase-by-phase replay:** Break every shot into phases and review what happened on each rep.
- **Deficiency zoom:** Instant spot-on zoom into the form break that cost the shot.
- **Energy breakdown:** See how power and energy move through your motion.
- **Session review:** Wrap the workout with a clear summary of what improved and what to fix next.

## Mo remembers every shot and every improvement

Mo has context for every shot you take, every improvement you make, and is always there to accompany your journey.

- **Session memory:** Mo remembers what you worked on and how you shot.
- **Personalized plans:** Guidance and plans stay tied to your real training history.
- **Hey Mo / Hey Monona:** Talk to Mo during Live Shoot and get answers in realtime.

### Meet Mo

Our mascot Mo understands and tracks all your shots and data, then tailors personalized plans just for you.

## Every progress is tracked

Streaks, daily and weekly shot goals, live shots by day, and session history so nothing gets lost.

- Shot goal rings and weekly counts
- Live shots by day chart
- Session history that stays with you

## Frequently asked questions

### What is Hoop Mo?

Hoop Mo is an AI basketball shooting coach with Live Shoot realtime feedback, Mo chat that remembers every shot, and progress tracking. Free on iOS.

### What is Live Shoot?

Live Shoot is Hoop Mo's realtime training mode. It gives feedback on each release as you shoot, lets you talk to Mo, and includes phase-by-phase replay, deficiency zoom, energy breakdown, and session review.

### How do I talk to Mo?

During Live Shoot, say "Hey Mo" or "Hey Monona", then ask your question. Mo answers in realtime and uses your shot data to give personalized guidance and plans.

### Does Mo remember my sessions?

Yes. Mo has context for every shot you take and every improvement you make, so advice and plans stay tied to your real training history.

### Is Hoop Mo free?

Yes. Hoop Mo is a free AI basketball shooting coach on iOS, including Live Shoot, Mo chat, and progress tracking.

### What do I need to record my shot?

Use your iPhone to film from a side view with one shooter and one basketball in frame. A clear view of your full shooting motion from setup through follow-through gives the best results.

### Where is pro player comparison?

Pro form matching and NBA model comparison live on the Pro Comparison page: https://monona-sports.com/pro-comparison.html

## https://monona-sports.com/pro-comparison.html

# Pro Player Comparison | Hoop Mo

Hoop Mo is an AI basketball shooting coach that compares your form to 70+ NBA players with phase-by-phase similarity and pro-level analytics.

**Stats:** 70+ NBA pros | 6 shot phases analyzed | Similarity scores and analytics

## Your AI basketball shooting coach toolkit

Diagnose inconsistency, compare mechanics to pros, and get drills for release timing, balance, elbow path, and follow-through.

- **70+ NBA Pros:** Choose your model player and study the form traits that make them elite.
- **Auto-Matched Style:** Get an instant similarity score and see how your shot compares phase by phase.
- **Phase Breakdown:** Skeletal tracking and joint angles at setpoint, rising, release, and more.
- **AI Coaching:** Personalized advice across every shot phase, clear and actionable with no jargon.
- **Pro-Level Analytics:** Release timing, windup paths, and angle gauges benchmarked against your pro match.
- **Share Highlights:** Export your match cards and share your progress on social media.
- **Personalized Drills (BETA):** Daily drills built from your analysis: balance, flat arch, follow-through, and more.

### Personalized Drills and Workout Plans

Hoop Mo builds a daily workout plan from your shot analysis, not generic drills, but exercises targeting your specific form issues.

- Your workout plan: a curated daily list based on what your analysis finds
- Targeted categories: balance, flat arch, follow-through, hand placement, setpoint, and more
- Track progress: completion ring shows how many drills you've finished today
- Actionable drills: e.g. "Keep guide hand off the ball", "One-hand follow-through"

## How Hoop Mo Works

Four steps from recording to improvement.

1. **Record Your Shot:** Film your shooting form from a side view using your smartphone camera.
2. **AI Analysis:** Our AI processes your video, normalizes the data, and breaks down each phase of your shot.
3. **Pro Comparison:** Your form is matched against 70+ professional players to find your best style fit.
4. **Get Insights:** Review coaching advice, visual graphs, and replay to improve your game.

## Who it's for

Players, parents, trainers, and AAU coaches who want clear answers on shooting mechanics.

- **Players:** Find out why your make rate swings game to game and get drills that target your actual form breaks.
- **Parents:** See exactly what to work on at home with objective feedback.
- **Trainers:** Back your coaching with phase breakdowns and pro comparisons.
- **AAU coaches:** Show slow-motion breakdowns in practice and give every player a consistent standard.

## Frequently asked questions

### Can I compare my form to NBA players?

Yes. Hoop Mo matches your shot to 70+ NBA players or lets you pick a model player. You get phase-by-phase comparison, similarity percentages, and visual replay side by side with pros.

### How does Hoop Mo analyze my shot?

Record your shot from a side view with your phone. Hoop Mo tracks body keypoints, breaks your motion into phases like setup and release, and compares your form to NBA player models with similarity scores and coaching tips.

### Is Pro Comparison different from Live Shoot?

Yes. Live Shoot is realtime in-gym coaching with Mo. Pro Comparison focuses on matching your recorded form to NBA models. Both are in the same free app. See Live Shoot: https://monona-sports.com/

### Is Hoop Mo free?

Yes. Hoop Mo is a free AI basketball shooting coach on iOS. You can record shots, get AI analysis, pro comparisons, and personalized drills at no cost.

# Blog | Hoop Mo

Basketball shooting technique guides from Hoop Mo, an AI basketball shooting coach.

## Articles

- [Fix Your Shooting Release](https://monona-sports.com/blog/fix-your-shooting-release.html): Clean fingertip finish, timing, and pocket-to-release path.
- [Elbow Path and Alignment](https://monona-sports.com/blog/elbow-path-and-alignment.html): Keep the elbow under the ball on a straight path.
- [Follow-Through Consistency](https://monona-sports.com/blog/follow-through-consistency.html): Hold the finish for soft arc and fewer short misses.

---

## https://monona-sports.com/blog/fix-your-shooting-release.html

# Fix Your Shooting Release

How to clean up a rushed or flat basketball shooting release with fingertip finish, timing, and a consistent pocket-to-release path.

Key tips: finish through the fingertips, match pocket to release timing, keep the guide hand quiet, and practice under light fatigue. Pair with Hoop Mo Live Shoot for realtime release cues and phase replay.

---

## https://monona-sports.com/blog/elbow-path-and-alignment.html

# Elbow Path and Alignment

How to keep your shooting elbow under the ball and on a straight path so your shot stays on line.

Key tips: stack elbow under the ball, keep the rise path straight, fix set-point load before forcing the elbow, and train alignment when fresh. Hoop Mo phase breakdown highlights where the path breaks.

---

## https://monona-sports.com/blog/follow-through-consistency.html

# Follow-Through Consistency

How to hold a consistent basketball shooting follow-through for softer arc and fewer short misses.

Key tips: hold the finish for a full count, aim for soft arc, keep the same finish on contested shots, and use a simple verbal cue. Live Shoot session review shows whether the finish held from rep to rep.

# Privacy Notice

**Last updated:** January 2026
**Developed by:** Ti Wu and Hyuntaek Oh

This Privacy Notice explains how we collect, use, store, and protect user information when you use Hoop Mo, our AI basketball shooting coach mobile application ("the App").

By using the App, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Notice.

## 1. Information We Collect

### A. Information You Provide

We may collect information you voluntarily provide, including:

- Name or nickname
- Email address
- Player profile details (e.g., height, dominant hand, position)
- Feedback or support messages

You may choose not to provide certain information, but some features may be unavailable.

### B. Video and Motion Data

If you choose to upload or record videos for analysis:

- Basketball shooting videos
- Extracted body keypoints and motion data derived from the video

**Important:**

- We do not perform facial recognition
- We do not identify individuals
- Videos are used only for performance analysis

### C. Automatically Collected Data

We may automatically collect limited technical data such as:

- Device type and OS version
- App usage events (e.g., feature usage, crashes)
- Anonymous identifiers for analytics

This data is used only to improve app stability and performance.

## 2. How We Use Your Information

We use collected information to:

- Analyze basketball shooting mechanics
- Provide AI-generated performance feedback
- Improve model accuracy and app experience
- Maintain app functionality and security
- Respond to support requests

We do not use your data for advertising or profiling.

## 3. AI and Machine Learning Usage

Our App uses AI and computer-vision models to analyze basketball shooting form.

- Models process uploaded videos or derived motion data
- AI outputs are performance feedback only
- Data is not used for identity recognition
- Training datasets are anonymized when used

## 4. Data Storage and Retention

- Videos and analysis results are stored only as long as necessary to provide the service
- Users may delete their videos and data at any time
- Deleted data is permanently removed from active systems within a reasonable timeframe

## 5. Data Sharing

We do not sell or rent personal data.

We may share limited data only with:

- Secure cloud service providers (e.g., storage, analytics)
- Legal authorities if required by law

All third-party services are required to follow strict confidentiality and security obligations.

## 6. Children's Privacy

- The App is not directed at children under 13
- We do not knowingly collect personal data from children
- If such data is discovered, it will be deleted promptly

## 7. Your Rights

Depending on your location, you may have the right to:

- Access your data
- Request correction or deletion
- Withdraw consent

Requests can be made by contacting us directly.

## 8. Security

We take reasonable measures to protect user data, including:

- Encrypted data transmission
- Secure cloud infrastructure
- Access controls

No system is 100% secure, but we continuously improve protections.

## 9. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Notice from time to time. Changes will be reflected by updating the "Last updated" date.

## 10. Contact Us

If you have questions or requests regarding this Privacy Notice:

- Email: support@monona-sports.com
- Developers: Ti Wu and Hyuntaek Oh
